external_context.description: Identifier and optional title of the existing external issue to link, as returned by the search-issues endpoint. Required keys depend on the integration kind: github -> {repository, number}; gitlab -> {issue_id}; linear -> {id}; jira -> {key}. For GitHub, add resource_type 'pull_request' to link a pull request instead of an issue.

integration_id.description: ID of the connected integration the existing issue lives in (one of 'github', 'gitlab', 'linear', 'jira').

issue.description: ID of the error tracking issue to link the reference to.
